title: Table
description: Columnar table representation with explicit column names, inferred data types, and rows as arrays of values without repeated keys. Null values are strictly null.

cols.description: Ordered list of column names. Column names must be unique strings.

types.description: Inferred data type for each column matching cols index.

rows.description: Rows represented as arrays of primitive cell values. Nulls are represented strictly as null.
